verdict.rationale: Granola Chat explicitly supports drafting and sending a follow-up email directly from meeting notes as a documented workflow, with sales-relevant templates (e.g., sales pitch note templates) and CRM sync options for follow-through. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on review confirming the 'couple of clicks' review-and-send UX in practice, and no detail on how much editing/review is typically needed before sending.
